beats.text: Far away in his uncle's kingdom, Bharata had a terrible dream about his father.
Bharata was away when all this happened. Messengers called him home in haste, without telling him why.
He felt something was wrong the moment he saw the silent city. No one greeted him. No one smiled.
Kaikeyi proudly told him: 'Your father is gone. Rama is in exile. The throne is yours.'
Bharata was shattered. 'You have destroyed my family for my sake? You are no mother of mine! I want nothing of this.'
He ran to Kaushalya, fell at her feet and swore he had known nothing of the plot.
He performed his father's last rites with Shatrughna, weeping beside the funeral fire.
When the ministers offered him the crown, he refused it. He set out to bring his brother home.
